judgement.one_sentence_verdict: A pleasant but ordinary sky with a decent cumulus bank, weakened by a heavy foreground wall and rooftops.
strengths: textured cloud bank along the horizon
good contrast between clouds and rooftops
weaknesses: foreground wall and rooftops take up too much attention
clouds are low and fairly ordinary
